content:
Grouping follows the **APPLICATION CODE LIST** (CMIS application codes 1–4). Optical/electrical figures in **TECHNICAL DATA** are module-wide (not per application row), so the same Tx/Rx and FEC values apply to each mode where the datasheet does not split them.

      "label": "CMIS App 1: 4x100GBASE-DR breakout",

      "frame": "2x 50G",
      "standards_code": "100GBASE-DR",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 400.0,
      "tx_power_min_dbm": -1.4,
